description: Steady brings complete context about what's going on at work into your ChatGPT workflows. It continuously distills plans, progress, and activity across your tools and teams — so every conversation starts with the full story instead of a blank slate. Catch up on what you missed, ask questions about projects and goals, or post updates directly from ChatGPT.
